meta.description: Execute and test GraphQL depth limit attacks using deeply nested recursive queries to identify denial-of-service vulnerabilities in GraphQL APIs.

copy.tagline_en: Test GraphQL APIs for depth-limit DoS vulnerabilities

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能生成递归深度、别名放大、片段传播等GraphQL查询，自动测试API深度限制，识别拒绝服务漏洞。
howto.when: 当你要对GraphQL端点进行安全评估、测试深度限制或验证防护措施时，Claude可以生成并执行攻击查询。

say.text: 对我的GraphQL端点执行深度限制攻击测试。
say.note: Claude会自动生成递增深度的查询并报告结果。

say.text: 使用别名放大攻击测试100次，检查性能影响。
say.note: Claude会生成多别名查询并测量响应时间。

howto.what_en: Enables Claude to generate recursive depth, alias amplification, fragment spread, field duplication, and batch queries; automatically test GraphQL APIs for depth limit vulnerabilities and denial-of-service risks.
howto.when_en: When performing security assessments, incident response, scheduled testing, or validating controls on GraphQL endpoints; typical trigger is a request to execute depth limit attack testing.

say_en.text: Perform a depth limit attack on my GraphQL endpoint.
Generate a recursive query with depth 5 and send to http://example.com/graphql.
say_en.note: Claude will construct and send the nested query.

say_en.text: Test alias amplification with 100 aliases to check performance impact.
say_en.note: Claude will generate alias-amplified queries and measure response times.
